General & Multi-Discipline · Revit Add-in

Instance Parameter Transfer

Move Revit instance data in batches you can review.

Copy, move, clear, or assign instance parameter values across selected Revit elements, with compatible target parameters shown for the chosen source.

Request Demo on WhatsApp Compare Workflows
Key features

Keep the values that belong to each individual element

When a project standard changes, every instance may carry a different value. Transfer those values as a batch while keeping the element-by-element relationships.

  • 01

    Browse all categories → select a type → view all available instance parameters

  • 02

    Transfer values from one instance parameter to another (Move or Copy)

  • 03

    Target parameter list filtered by compatible storage type

    no type mismatch errors

  • 04

    Supports all storage types

    String, Integer, Double, Element ID

  • 05

    Clear (delete) parameter values in bulk

  • 06

    Directly assign a custom value to any parameter for all selected elements at once

Workflow comparison

Manual Revit vs. Instance Parameter Transfer

TaskManual Revit workflowWith Instance Parameter Transfer
Select the instances to updateManual Revit workflowBuild a matching selection or schedule from the model.With Instance Parameter TransferChoose a category and type, then select the instances in scope.
Transfer valuesManual Revit workflowCopy values individually or set up an editable schedule for the transfer.With Instance Parameter TransferChoose the source and a compatible target, then copy or move the values.
Clean up or assign new dataManual Revit workflowEdit or clear values element by element or in an editable schedule.With Instance Parameter TransferClear the selected parameter or assign a specified value across the selection.
Illustrative time comparison

Copying values between compatible instance parameters

Both parameters are defined, writable where needed, and compatible. Estimates include checking representative values after the transfer. These are planning estimates. Actual times depend on the model and setup.

Twenty instances

Manual in Revit

8–15 min

Select the elements, copy or edit the values, and verify them.

Instance Parameter Transfer

30–75 sec

Choose the parameters, apply the copy, and spot-check the results.

6.75–14.5 min estimated savings

Five hundred instances

Manual in Revit

45–90 min

Use a schedule or another bulk editing method and verify the mapping.

Instance Parameter Transfer

2–4 min

Select the applicable instances, copy values, and sample-check the mapping.

41–88 min estimated savings
